title: Annual Tech Symposium 2026 - Call for Speakers
content:
Starlight University's {{symposium_year}} Tech Symposium will be held on {{symposium_date}} at the Student Center Grand Hall.

This year's theme: "Building the Future with AI and Machine Learning"

We are seeking student and faculty speakers for 20-minute lightning talks. Topics of interest include:

  • Large Language Models and Their Applications
  • Computer Vision and Edge AI
  • Ethical AI and Responsible Innovation
  • Cloud-Native Architecture

Submit your talk proposal by {{symposium_cfp_deadline}} via the university portal. Selected speakers will receive a certificate of recognition.

All students and faculty are welcome to attend. Registration is free but required for headcount.

title: AI Tools Academic Integrity Policy - Effective {{policy_effective}}
content:
The Office of Academic Affairs has released the updated Academic Integrity Policy regarding the use of AI tools in coursework.

Key points:

  • Students may use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) for research and brainstorming unless explicitly prohibited by the instructor
  • AI-generated content must be properly cited and disclosed
  • Submitting AI-generated work as one's own without disclosure is a violation
  • Instructors will specify per assignment whether AI assistance is permitted

This policy is effective {{policy_effective}} and applies to all courses. The full policy document is available on the university website.

Contact the Office of Academic Affairs with questions.

title: Guest Lecture: The Future of Quantum Computing
content:
The CSE Department will host a guest lecture by Dr. {{lecturer_name}} from {{lecturer_affiliation}}.

Topic: "The Future of Quantum Computing: From Theory to Real-World Applications"

Date: {{lecture_date}}
Time: {{lecture_time}}
Location: {{lecture_room}}

title: CSE 310 - Database Lab Closure This Weekend
content:

title: Dean's Excellence Scholarship - Applications Open
content:
The College of Engineering and Applied Sciences accepts applications for the Dean's Excellence Scholarship for Spring {{next_semester_year}}.

Eligibility:

  • Enrolled CSE major with at least 60 credit hours completed
  • Minimum GPA of 3.5
  • Demonstrated leadership in campus activities or community service

Award: {{scholarship_amount}} per semester (renewable for one year)

Required documents:

  • Completed application form
  • Official transcript
  • Two letters of recommendation
  • Personal statement (500 words)

Application deadline: {{scholarship_deadline}}

Apply through the Financial Aid portal. Contact dean.scholarships@starlight.edu with questions.
